Rules (recommended to read first!):
1. Notify people in the comments before starting a remix so they don't accidentally split the remix tree's branches.
2. Make sure your remix follows the community guidelines. (obvious rule)
3. Be respectful to anyone, so nothing too mean and don't try to ruin or raid it.
4. Remember that you will remix again after 2 remixes by others.
5. You can dodge, but don't dodge too many times.
6. If there is too many remixes, you can add a skip button to speed up the project.
7. NEVER delete any of these rules or instructions or completely change the project's title.
8. Do not delete modify anything you didn't make, unless you want to fix glitches, errors, rule-breaks, or remove unused scripts.
9. No bitmap images, even if you animate them, background included or not.
10. No intros and outros otherwise it would slow down the project.
